doc.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023

chapter: New York and the WDR Big Band
title: Deciding to go to New York and the New School
summary: She went to the New School alone after her boyfriend backed out, and is glad she left her comfort zone.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was coming to the United States a foregone conclusion or well if you really want to excel that’s the next step for you?

I actually did not see myself going to New York initially. My boyfriend at the time, he was a tenor saxophone player, he talked about going to New York all the time. And then I thought okay, all right, I’ll go, I’ll go. And then I ended up going to the New School and he changed his mind and he didn’t end up going so I went by myself. So this was really — I wouldn’t say it was a must or it felt like the only way to become, to better myself © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

was to go to New York but I’m sure glad that I did because I certainly wouldn’t have learned so many of those things that I learned in New York if I hadn’t gone there and left my comfort zone and really jumped into the cold pool many, many, many times.
